audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2-3 were given to Yorick and 4-5 and 6 were Skill, while the matching whys read 'it stays even', 'Your full Q-W combo is online', 'You out-trade a Yorick', and 'All Out ... win the 1v1'.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Skill / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Yorick, matching those whys and the 48.7% win rate over 690 games — K'Sante owns 3 to 6, Yorick owns the scaling.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 realigned in matched pairs; the first-item why reworded so it genuinely reads contested rather than K'Sante-favoured.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, and Yorick's abilities were never named — the packet flags exactly that.
audit.why: Dark Procession 20/18/16/14/12s, Mourning Mist 12/11/10/9/8s, Last Rites 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s. The wall's 20s at rank 1 is the punish window the page was already pointing at without ever quantifying.
audit.corrected: Spikes and whys now carry the real names and the 12s and 20s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) The text calls Mourning Mist (E) a cage that roots — 'bait his E (it slows and cages)', 'Land E mist-cage to root you in place'. Mourning Mist damages, slows, reduces armour and marks; the cage is Dark Procession (W), a destructible wall. (b) It claims 'if you W-charge into the slow you become unstoppable'. Also, Last Rites' heal and attack-reset were never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies'. Riot's W text: 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement'. K'Sante's W text says only 'taking reduced damage'. Last Rites 'deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself' and carries the autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: E is a slow and armour shred you charge through; W is the wall you avoid being boxed by; Last Rites is named as the attack-reset heal that Grievous Wounds answers.

edits.before: He has only Q at level 1 too, but his ghouls and E mist let him poke for free — last-hit at Q tip and don't walk into ghoul range.
edits.after: He has only Last Rites at level 1 too, but Mist Walkers and Mourning Mist poke free — last-hit at Q tip, out of ghoul range.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo is online — W-charge through his E slow to land the stun, then Q3 knock-up before Maiden exists.
edits.after: Your Q-W is online — W-charge through Mourning Mist's slow for the stun, then the Ntofo pull, before Maiden exists.

edits.before: You out-trade a Yorick who must path past his own ghouls, and you bank leads around his E cage cooldown.
edits.after: You out-trade a Yorick who must path past his own ghouls, banking leads on Mourning Mist's 12s cooldown.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet makes you durable enough to dive his wave and force the all-in while his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn makes you durable enough to dive his wave, but Maiden's sustained DPS answers it — genuinely contested.

edits.before: Full Maiden + ghouls + W wall let him 1v1 through your armor and splitpush faster than your R-peel team answers.
edits.after: Maiden, ghouls and Dark Procession's wall let him 1v1 through your armour and split faster than your team answers.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo lands — W-charge through his E cage to stun him, then Q3 knock-up: your one clean melee window before Maiden.
edits.after: Your Q-W lands — W-charge through Mourning Mist's slow to stun him, then the Ntofo pull: your clean melee window before Maiden.

edits.before: All Out lets you dash through him and survive a ghoul-swarm burst, but it strips your tankiness right as Maiden adds sustained DPS, so commit only when his E is down.
edits.after: All Out lets you dash through him and survive the ghoul swarm, but it strips your bulk right as Maiden adds sustained DPS — commit only with Dark Procession down.

edits.before: Yorick's threat window: full Maiden + ghouls + W wall trap him on you in a side lane and he 1v1s or splits faster than you can answer.
edits.after: Yorick's threat window: Maiden, ghouls and a 12s Dark Procession wall box you in the side lane, and he 1v1s or splits faster than you answer.

edits.before: Level 1 you have only Q, no engage, and walking into ghoul range just lets him stack E mist on you for free — last-hit at the tip of your Q and concede the level. The lane flips at 3 once your full kit is online: bait his E (it slows and cages, but if you W-charge into the slow you become unstoppable and the stun still lands), then Q3 to knock him up. His ghouls don't matter if you only commit when Maiden isn't up — that's the whole early game.
edits.after: Level 1 you have only Q, no engage, and walking into ghoul range just lets him stack Mourning Mist on you for free — last-hit at the tip of your Q and concede the level. The lane flips at 3 once your kit is online: bait Mourning Mist, 12s at rank 1, then W-charge through the slow for the stun and pull him in with the 2-stack Ntofo. Watch his auto wind-up — Last Rites is an attack reset that heals him, so carry Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are yours as a tank — you out-trade a Yorick who has to walk past his own ghouls to hit you, and you bank small leads around his E cooldown. At 6 your R is a real 1v1: you dash through him, eat the ghoul-swarm burst your W charge already absorbed, and your duelist profile beats him before he stacks a full Maiden — but it sheds your bulk, so don't pop it into a fresh Maiden + ghoul wall. Force the all-in while his E is down; that's when he's just a melee with no escape.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours as a tank — you out-trade a Yorick who has to walk past his own ghouls to reach you, and you bank small leads on Mourning Mist's 12s cooldown. At 6 your R is a real 1v1: launch him, eat the ghoul burst your W charge already reduced, and your duelist profile beats him before Maiden is stacked — but it sheds your bulk, so never pop it into a fresh Maiden. Force the all-in while Dark Procession is down; that is when he is a melee with no wall.

edits.before: Bait his E mist-slow, then W-charge through it so the stun lands and Q3 knocks him up before ghouls stack
edits.after: Bait Mourning Mist, then W-charge through the slow so the stun lands and the Ntofo pull follows

edits.before: Land E mist-cage to root you in place while ghouls and Maiden chunk you down
edits.after: Box you in with Dark Procession's wall while ghouls and Maiden chunk you down

edits.before: Avoid your Q3 and W stun, summon Maiden, and grind the side lane until his splitpush outpaces you
edits.after: Avoid the Ntofo pull and W stun, summon Maiden, and grind the side lane until his split outpaces you

notes: Corrected a swapped ability: the page treated Mourning Mist (E) as a root/cage. Mourning Mist damages, slows, shreds armour and marks; the cage is Dark Procession (W), a destructible wall. Also removed 'W-charge into the slow you become unstoppable' — not in K'Sante's kit data.
